lines: и паки вєрѧѥмъ єдиного бг҃а, ѿ(т)ц҃а
notes: Card contains creedal formula (Nicene Creed excerpt) about Trinity. Text is upside down in image - card must be rotated 180° to read correctly. Archaic orthography preserved: ѿ ot-ligature, є where visible on card, бг҃а, ѿ(т)ц҃а, сн҃а, сп҃са, с҃т҃ого дх҃а with titlo marks. Source line at bottom reads 'Варшава, 1637' - Warsaw 1637 collection.
